# Plan: Tips (dialog, toolbar button, automatic ask, Settings section)

Tree: `/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-tips` (branch `tips`, 34c7fea2, clean). Every path
below is relative to it. No STOP: the choices only the owner can make are under "Owner choices",
each with the recommendation this plan builds on.

## Goal

1. **Dialog.** One small dialog that says plainly who a tip funds (one developer, an open-source
   app), with "Leave a Tip" opening `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` (one constant) and
   "Not Now".
2. **Toolbar button.** A green "Tips" button right of Export… in the editor toolbar that shows
   the dialog, removable by deleting one file and one line.
3. **Automatic ask.** The dialog shown by itself, once per due moment: first after 30 days and 5
   exports a person made, then once a year in December, skipping a December that starts less
   than six months after the last ask. Never in an agent- or proof-driven instance.
4. **Settings.** A Tips section whose toggle turns off the automatic ask and removes the toolbar
   button, and whose own Tips button always shows the dialog.

## Owner choices (planned on the recommendation)

| # | Choice | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Exports before the first ask | **5** |
| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | **The first export a person completed from the export card**, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof do, so a key stamped at launch would count agent-only use and trip `DEFAULTS MOVED` on a fresh domain. Not "30 distinct days used": a casual user would wait a year. |
| O3 | "December" and "six months" | Any moment whose month is December in the **Gregorian calendar in the Mac's current time zone**. A December is skipped **whole** when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask (so: last ask after 1 June 00:00 of that year skips it). Judged whole so the ask cannot appear on, say, 30 December because the last one was on 30 June. |
| O4 | Dialog form | **Its own small window** titled "Tips" (the Settings window's mould), not a sheet and not an app-modal alert. It needs no host window (Settings and the Welcome state have no document), it cannot block a window or a tool call, and it adds no sheet site to the menu inventory. |
| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when an export a person confirmed in the export card completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed (Close or Show in Finder); for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It is ordered front **without taking key**, so Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip". |
| O6 | What counts as "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door (someone who just visited the page is not asked again that December). Opening the dialog by hand and choosing Not Now records nothing. |
| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564, the brand mark's green, `Theme.swift:40`) with the white `DS.onAccent` label: 4.57:1, the same in light and dark, as the recorder's coral Record button is. `DS.action` is reserved to the action lane (CI-4). |
| O8 | Wording (drafts, American spelling, held by `ai_docs_r2c_proof.py` T1) | Window title "Tips". Heading: "Frame Job is free and open source". Body: "Frame Job is made by one developer. It is free to use and its source is open. If it is useful to you, a tip helps pay for the time to keep working on it. Tips are voluntary, and nothing in Frame Job is locked without one." Hint: "You can turn this reminder off in Frame Job ▸ Settings… ▸ Tips." Buttons: "Not Now", "Leave a Tip". Settings blurb: "Frame Job is free and open source, made by one developer. Tips are voluntary." Checkbox: "Show the Tips button and the yearly reminder". Toolbar tooltip: "Support Frame Job". |

Counting continues while the toggle is off (two local numbers; turning it back on then behaves
sensibly). The in-app Assistant's `export` is the agent's door and does not count.

## What is true now

- **Toolbar.** `buildToolbar()` ends its row with the Export `AccentButton`
  (`app/Sources/EditorViewController+Toolbar.swift:81-91`). `AccentButton` already takes
  `fill:` (`Controls.swift:137-153`); the recorder passes `DS.meterClip`
  (`RecorderPanelController.swift:224`). `AccentButton` is `final`. `Controls.swift` is 648
  lines, over the cap, so it takes nothing. The editor's minimum window is 900 × 620
  (`EditorWindowController.swift:15`).

  transcriptionPane, playbackPane]` (`SettingsWindowController.swift:228`), 464 lines.
  `PlaybackSettingsPane.swift` is the mould for a pane with a checkbox that saves at once;
  `BackgroundRenderSettings` (`BackgroundRender.swift:7-35`) the mould for "Bool, absent = true".
  `showSettings` lives on `AppDelegate` at the foot of the window's file (`:455-464`).

  (`ExportSheetCommit.swift:76-86`): `beginExport` presents `ExportProgressSheetController`
  (`EditorViewController+Export.swift:50-61`) and `enqueueExport` calls
  `ExportQueueController.shared.enqueue` (`:83-95`). No dev switch accepts that panel, and no
  proof calls either method (grep of `tools/proof`: probes build

- **Agent export.** `AgentServer+Export.swift:90` enqueues on the same shared queue directly and
  follows its job by id through `AgentExports`. The queue's `Job` has no origin, `enqueue`
  returns the id (`ExportQueueController.swift:313`), `finished` sets `.completed` and posts
  `didChangeNotification` synchronously (`:416-470`, `:531`), `job(_:)` reads one (`:284`).

  launch, or by the agent's `export`, fails every proof on a fresh domain.

below is relative to it. No STOP: the choices only the owner can make are under "Owner choices",
each with the recommendation this plan builds on.

## Goal

1. **Dialog.** One small dialog that says plainly who a tip funds (one developer, an open-source
   app), with "Leave a Tip" opening `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` (one constant) and
   "Not Now".
2. **Toolbar button.** A green "Tips" button right of Export… in the editor toolbar that shows
   the dialog, removable by deleting one file and one line.
3. **Automatic ask.** The dialog shown by itself, once per due moment: first after 30 days and 5
   exports a person made, then once a year in December, skipping a December that starts less
   than six months after the last ask. Never in an agent- or proof-driven instance.
4. **Settings.** A Tips section whose toggle turns off the automatic ask and removes the toolbar
   button, and whose own Tips button always shows the dialog.

## Owner choices (planned on the recommendation)

| # | Choice | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Exports before the first ask | **5** |
| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | **The first export a person completed from the export card**, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof do, so a key stamped at launch would count agent-only use and trip `DEFAULTS MOVED` on a fresh domain. Not "30 distinct days used": a casual user would wait a year. |
| O3 | "December" and "six months" | Any moment whose month is December in the **Gregorian calendar in the Mac's current time zone**. A December is skipped **whole** when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask (so: last ask after 1 June 00:00 of that year skips it). Judged whole so the ask cannot appear on, say, 30 December because the last one was on 30 June. |
| O4 | Dialog form | **Its own small window** titled "Tips" (the Settings window's mould), not a sheet and not an app-modal alert. It needs no host window (Settings and the Welcome state have no document), it cannot block a window or a tool call, and it adds no sheet site to the menu inventory. |
| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when an export a person confirmed in the export card completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed (Close or Show in Finder); for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It is ordered front **without taking key**, so Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip". |
| O6 | What counts as "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door (someone who just visited the page is not asked again that December). Opening the dialog by hand and choosing Not Now records nothing. |
| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564, the brand mark's green, `Theme.swift:40`) with the white `DS.onAccent` label: 4.57:1, the same in light and dark, as the recorder's coral Record button is. `DS.action` is reserved to the action lane (CI-4). |

It is free to use and its source is open. If it is useful to you, a tip helps pay for the time to keep working on it. Tips are voluntary, and nothing in Frame Job is locked without one." Hint: "You can turn this reminder off in Frame Job ▸ Settings… ▸ Tips." Buttons: "Not Now", "Leave a Tip". Settings blurb: "Frame Job is free and open source, made by one developer. # Plan: Tips (dialog, toolbar button, automatic ask, Settings section)

Tree: `/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-tips` (branch `tips`, 34c7fea2, clean). Every path
below is relative to it. No STOP: the choices only the owner can make are under "Owner choices",
each with the recommendation this plan builds on.

## Goal

1. **Dialog.** One small dialog that says plainly who a tip funds (one developer, an open-source
   app), with "Leave a Tip" opening `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` (one constant) and
   "Not Now".
2. **Toolbar button.** A green "Tips" button right of Export… in the editor toolbar that shows
   the dialog, removable by deleting one file and one line.
3. **Automatic ask.** The dialog shown by itself, once per due moment: first after 30 days and 5
   exports a person made, then once a year in December, skipping a December that starts less
   than six months after the last ask. Never in an agent- or proof-driven instance.
4. **Settings.** A Tips section whose toggle turns off the automatic ask and removes the toolbar
   button, and whose own Tips button always shows the dialog.

## Owner choices (planned on the recommendation)

| # | Choice | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Exports before the first ask | **5** |
| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | **The first export a person completed from the export card**, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof do, so a key stamped at launch would count agent-only use and trip `DEFAULTS MOVED` on a fresh domain. Not "30 distinct days used": a casual user would wait a year. |
| O3 | "December" and "six months" | Any moment whose month is December in the **Gregorian calendar in the Mac's current time zone**. A December is skipped **whole** when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask (so: last ask after 1 June 00:00 of that year skips it). Judged whole so the ask cannot appear on, say, 30 December because the last one was on 30 June. |
| O4 | Dialog form | **Its own small window** titled "Tips" (the Settings window's mould), not a sheet and not an app-modal alert. It needs no host window (Settings and the Welcome state have no document), it cannot block a window or a tool call, and it adds no sheet site to the menu inventory. |
| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when an export a person confirmed in the export card completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed (Close or Show in Finder); for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It is ordered front **without taking key**, so Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip". |
| O6 | What counts as "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door (someone who just visited the page is not asked again that December). Opening the dialog by hand and choosing Not Now records nothing. |
| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564, the brand mark's green, `Theme.swift:40`) with the white `DS.onAccent` label: 4.57:1, the same in light and dark, as the recorder's coral Record button is. `DS.action` is reserved to the action lane (CI-4). |
| O8 | Wording (drafts, American spelling, held by `ai_docs_r2c_proof.py` T1) | Window title "Tips". Heading: "Frame Job is free and open source". Body: "Frame Job is made by one developer. It is free to use and its source is open. If it is useful to you, a tip helps pay for the time to keep working on it. Tips are voluntary, and nothing in Frame Job is locked without one." Hint: "You can turn this reminder off in Frame Job ▸ Settings… ▸ Tips." Buttons: "Not Now", "Leave a Tip". Settings blurb: "Frame Job is free and open source, made by one developer. ## Owner choices (the plan builds on each recommendation)

| # | Choice | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Exports before the first ask | 5 |
| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | The first export a person completed from the export card, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch, because `framejob-mcp` and every proof also launch the app. |
| O3 | "December" and "six months" | December in the Gregorian calendar in the Mac's time zone. A December is skipped whole when 1 December is less than six calendar months after the last ask (last ask after 1 June). |
| O4 | Dialog form | Its own small non-modal window titled "Tips", not a sheet or an app-modal alert. |
| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when a card-confirmed export completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed; for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It never takes key. |
| O6 | What records "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door. A manual open followed by Not Now records nothing. |
| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564) with a white label, 4.57:1, the same in light and dark. |
| O8 | Wording | Drafts for the dialog, the Settings blurb, the checkbox and the tooltip are in the plan. |

## How the constraints are met

- **Never in an agent or proof instance:** all four defaults keys are written only at a person's doors. The two export doors both sit behind the export card's `NSSavePanel`, which no dev switch accepts and no proof calls. The agent's `export` enqueues directly and is never followed.
- **`DEFAULTS MOVED`:** nothing is written at launch or by an agent export, so the guard has nothing to see. A live row asserts this after an agent export.
- **No `-RCDev` switch and no dev tool:** the probe injects the clock and the store, and a person pins state with `defaults write`. Debug, Release and Distribution therefore behave identically.
- **Pure decision:** `TipsSchedule.isDue(state, now:, calendar:)` in a Foundation-only `Tips.swift`.
- **No frozen file is touched:** there are four new files (`Tips.swift`, `TipsWindowController.swift`, `TipsSettingsPane.swift`, `TipsToolbarButton.swift`). Removing the experiment is deleting the last one and one line in `EditorViewController+Toolbar.swift`.
- **Queue and controls untouched:** `ExportQueueController.swift` is not edited, because person jobs are followed by id as `AgentExports` does. `Controls.swift` is already over the cap at 648 lines and takes nothing.

## What the challenger should look at

- **Harness pin is off, not on.** `sharp_chrome.py:57` and `phase7_chrome.py:265` read the Export button at fixed toolbar points, so `pinDefaults` gets `"FrameJobTips": false`. `screens.py` pins it on. I did not run any older chrome proof.
- **Existing four-pane assertions must change in the same commit.** These are `settings_layout_probe.swift` L1 and L13, `assistant_tab_probe.swift` P7, and the two mutant anchors at `settings_layout_probe.py:130-137`, which `mutant_anchors.py` counts in `make test`.
- **`ExportProgressSheetController.swift` carries other proofs' anchors.** The plan adds only an `onSuccess` closure and one call, and rewords no existing line.
- **Menu inventory.** `inventory.py --check` finds sites by token, so the plan adds no new `presentAsSheet(`, `beginSheet(` or `runModal(`. This is one reason the dialog is a window.
- **Toolbar fit at 900 pt is an estimate.** I put it at about 760 pt today plus about 61 for Tips; probe row C2 measures it.
- **The site's captures will be stale.** They will not show the Tips button until re-imported; the plan leaves that out and drafts an issue for it.
- **The dialog has no screen-catalog entry.** No catalog step can open it; its look is a probe PNG plus a manual-check row.

## Proof shape

`tools/proof/tips_proof.py` with `tips_probe.swift`, in `settings_layout_probe.py`'s shape so `mutant_anchors.py` already reads its table. It has schedule rows S1–S10, state rows A1–A5, follower rows F1–F3 plus a tree-text row T1, chrome rows C1–C4, and live rows L0–L3 on the Debug app. Ten mutants cover the decisions. `tips_proof.py` is not added to `make test`.

The plan also covers spec §11 (`TIP-1`…`TIP-7` in a new `11-decisions/tips.md`, recorded before the code), the docs site page and `features.json` rows, `docs/manual-checks.md` rows, and the list of `CLAUDE.md` edits owed.

1	# Plan: Tips (dialog, toolbar button, automatic ask, Settings section)
2	
3	Tree: `/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-tips` (branch `tips`, 34c7fea2, clean). Every path
4	below is relative to it. No STOP: the choices only the owner can make are under "Owner choices",
5	each with the recommendation this plan builds on.
6	
7	## Goal
8	
9	1. **Dialog.** One small dialog that says plainly who a tip funds (one developer, an open-source
10	   app), with "Leave a Tip" opening `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` (one constant) and
11	   "Not Now".
12	2. **Toolbar button.** A green "Tips" button right of Export… in the editor toolbar that shows
13	   the dialog, removable by deleting one file and one line.
14	3. **Automatic ask.** The dialog shown by itself, once per due moment: first after 30 days and 5
15	   exports a person made, then once a year in December, skipping a December that starts less
16	   than six months after the last ask. Never in an agent- or proof-driven instance.
17	4. **Settings.** A Tips section whose toggle turns off the automatic ask and removes the toolbar
18	   button, and whose own Tips button always shows the dialog.
19	
20	## Owner choices (planned on the recommendation)
21	
22	| # | Choice | Recommendation |
23	|---|---|---|
24	| O1 | Exports before the first ask | **5** |
25	| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | **The first export a person completed from the export card**, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof do, so a key stamped at launch would count agent-only use and trip `DEFAULTS MOVED` on a fresh domain. Not "30 distinct days used": a casual user would wait a year. |
26	| O3 | "December" and "six months" | Any moment whose month is December in the **Gregorian calendar in the Mac's current time zone**. A December is skipped **whole** when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask (so: last ask after 1 June 00:00 of that year skips it). Judged whole so the ask cannot appear on, say, 30 December because the last one was on 30 June. |
27	| O4 | Dialog form | **Its own small window** titled "Tips" (the Settings window's mould), not a sheet and not an app-modal alert. It needs no host window (Settings and the Welcome state have no document), it cannot block a window or a tool call, and it adds no sheet site to the menu inventory. |
28	| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when an export a person confirmed in the export card completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed (Close or Show in Finder); for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It is ordered front **without taking key**, so Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip". |
29	| O6 | What counts as "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door (someone who just visited the page is not asked again that December). Opening the dialog by hand and choosing Not Now records nothing. |
30	| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564, the brand mark's green, `Theme.swift:40`) with the white `DS.onAccent` label: 4.57:1, the same in light and dark, as the recorder's coral Record button is. `DS.action` is reserved to the action lane (CI-4). |
31	| O8 | Wording (drafts, American spelling, held by `ai_docs_r2c_proof.py` T1) | Window title "Tips". Heading: "Frame Job is free and open source". Body: "Frame Job is made by one developer. It is free to use and its source is open. If it is useful to you, a tip helps pay for the time to keep working on it. Tips are voluntary, and nothing in Frame Job is locked without one." Hint: "You can turn this reminder off in Frame Job ▸ Settings… ▸ Tips." Buttons: "Not Now", "Leave a Tip". Settings blurb: "Frame Job is free and open source, made by one developer. Tips are voluntary." Checkbox: "Show the Tips button and the yearly reminder". Toolbar tooltip: "Support Frame Job". |
32	
33	Counting continues while the toggle is off (two local numbers; turning it back on then behaves
34	sensibly). The in-app Assistant's `export` is the agent's door and does not count.
35	
36	## What is true now
37	
38	- **Toolbar.** `buildToolbar()` ends its row with the Export `AccentButton`
39	  (`app/Sources/EditorViewController+Toolbar.swift:81-91`). `AccentButton` already takes
40	  `fill:` (`Controls.swift:137-153`); the recorder passes `DS.meterClip`
41	  (`RecorderPanelController.swift:224`). `AccentButton` is `final`. `Controls.swift` is 648

# Plan: Tips (dialog, toolbar button, automatic ask, Settings section)

Tree: `/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-tips` (branch `tips`, 34c7fea2, clean). Every path
below is relative to it. No STOP: the choices only the owner can make are under "Owner choices",
each with the recommendation this plan builds on.

## Goal

1. **Dialog.** One small dialog that says plainly who a tip funds (one developer, an open-source
   app), with "Leave a Tip" opening `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` (one constant) and
   "Not Now".
2. **Toolbar button.** A green "Tips" button right of Export… in the editor toolbar that shows
   the dialog, removable by deleting one file and one line.
3. **Automatic ask.** The dialog shown by itself, once per due moment: first after 30 days and 5
   exports a person made, then once a year in December, skipping a December that starts less
   than six months after the last ask. Never in an agent- or proof-driven instance.
4. **Settings.** A Tips section whose toggle turns off the automatic ask and removes the toolbar
   button, and whose own Tips button always shows the dialog.

## Owner choices (planned on the recommendation)

| # | Choice | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | Exports before the first ask | **5** |
| O2 | What "30 days of use" counts from | **The first export a person completed from the export card**, 30 × 24 h elapsed. Not first launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof do, so a key stamped at launch would count agent-only use and trip `DEFAULTS MOVED` on a fresh domain. Not "30 distinct days used": a casual user would wait a year. |
| O3 | "December" and "six months" | Any moment whose month is December in the **Gregorian calendar in the Mac's current time zone**. A December is skipped **whole** when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask (so: last ask after 1 June 00:00 of that year skips it). Judged whole so the ask cannot appear on, say, 30 December because the last one was on 30 June. |
| O4 | Dialog form | **Its own small window** titled "Tips" (the Settings window's mould), not a sheet and not an app-modal alert. It needs no host window (Settings and the Welcome state have no document), it cannot block a window or a tool call, and it adds no sheet site to the menu inventory. |
| O5 | When the automatic ask appears | Only when an export a person confirmed in the export card completes: for Export…, when its result sheet is closed (Close or Show in Finder); for Add to Queue, when the job completes. It is ordered front **without taking key**, so Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip". |
| O6 | What counts as "asked" | The automatic ask being shown, and a press of "Leave a Tip" from any door (someone who just visited the page is not asked again that December). Opening the dialog by hand and choosing Not Now records nothing. |
| O7 | The green | `DS.forest` (#1F8564, the brand mark's green, `Theme.swift:40`) with the white `DS.onAccent` label: 4.57:1, the same in light and dark, as the recorder's coral Record button is. `DS.action` is reserved to the action lane (CI-4). |
| O8 | Wording (drafts, American spelling, held by `ai_docs_r2c_proof.py` T1) | Window title "Tips". Heading: "Frame Job is free and open source". Body: "Frame Job is made by one developer. It is free to use and its source is open. If it is useful to you, a tip helps pay for the time to keep working on it. Tips are voluntary, and nothing in Frame Job is locked without one." Hint: "You can turn this reminder off in Frame Job ▸ Settings… ▸ Tips." Buttons: "Not Now", "Leave a Tip". Settings blurb: "Frame Job is free and open source, made by one developer. Tips are voluntary." Checkbox: "Show the Tips button and the yearly reminder". Toolbar tooltip: "Support Frame Job". |

Counting continues while the toggle is off (two local numbers; turning it back on then behaves
sensibly). The in-app Assistant's `export` is the agent's door and does not count.

## What is true now

- **Toolbar.** `buildToolbar()` ends its row with the Export `AccentButton`
  (`app/Sources/EditorViewController+Toolbar.swift:81-91`). `AccentButton` already takes
  `fill:` (`Controls.swift:137-153`); the recorder passes `DS.meterClip`
  (`RecorderPanelController.swift:224`). `AccentButton` is `final`. `Controls.swift` is 648
  lines, over the cap, so it takes nothing. The editor's minimum window is 900 × 620
  (`EditorWindowController.swift:15`).

  transcriptionPane, playbackPane]` (`SettingsWindowController.swift:228`), 464 lines.
  `PlaybackSettingsPane.swift` is the mould for a pane with a checkbox that saves at once;
  `BackgroundRenderSettings` (`BackgroundRender.swift:7-35`) the mould for "Bool, absent = true".
  `showSettings` lives on `AppDelegate` at the foot of the window's file (`:455-464`).

# Objections: Tips plan

Checked against `/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-tips` at 34c7fea2 (clean). The plan's "What
is true now" held everywhere I read it (toolbar row, `AccentButton(fill:)`, the two person doors,
the queue's `enqueue`/`finished`/`job(_:)`, the pane loop and the three probe rows that count
panes, the inventory's token-and-function match, `mcp.defaults_moved`). The schedule arithmetic
(O1-O3, S1-S10) is consistent with the request. Six objections, worst first.

## 1. The automatic ask's wiring has no row that can fail

**Claim.** Item 3's chain from a finished Export… to the dialog (`onSuccess` called in the
`.success` arm, `TipsDoors.exportSucceeded` counting, waiting for the sheet to end, `takeAsk`,
`showAutomatic`) is run by no row; the proof stays green with the chain dead or wrong.

**Evidence.**
- Delete the planned `onSuccess?()` line from `ExportProgressSheetController.finished`, or put
  it in the `.failure` arm (which also serves a cancel, `:209-219`): T1 only greps
  `TipsDoors.exportSucceeded(` in `EditorViewController+Export.swift`, A1/A2 call `TipsAsk`
  directly, C1 calls `showAutomatic()` directly, F1-F3 call the follower with an injected
  closure. Every row passes; no mutant names this.
- Same for the body of `TipsDoors.exportSucceeded(sheetOn:)` and `follow(queueJob:)`: they are
  built on `TipsAsk.shared` / `TipsWindowController.shared` and no row calls them. "Ask at
  success instead of at sheet end" and "never ask" both pass.
- L2 (agent `export` leaves no Tips window, no key moved) passes on the tree before any code
  and is never seen failing: mutants are probe rebuilds, so `agent-follows` is held by T1's
  tree text alone.
- The only end-to-end check is the `defaults write` row in `docs/manual-checks.md`, which a
  script can do: probes already run a real export through this sheet presented as
  `beginExport` presents it (`tools/proof/docs_bugs_b4_probe.swift:179`,
  `ai_docs_b2_probe.swift:132`).

**Suggested change.** Give `TipsDoors` its ask and window by injection (defaulting to the
shared ones) and add a probe row that runs a real `ExportProgressSheetController` export with
due state: nothing before the sheet ends, the window visible and last-asked written after, and
nothing on a cancelled or failed export, with a `success-unwired` mutant on the `onSuccess?()`
line.

## 2. C1's "not key" check passes for either door

**Claim.** O5's safety decision (the automatic ask never takes key, so Return cannot press
"Leave a Tip") is checked by a row that reads the same whichever method runs, and has no mutant.

**Evidence.** `app/Sources/EditorWindow.swift:272-275`: "a probe's window is never key, so its
key-window rows set [`keyWindowStandIn`]". In the probe process `show()` (key and front) also
leaves `isKeyWindow` false, so C1's "`showAutomatic()` leaves it visible and not key" would
pass with `showAutomatic()` calling `makeKeyAndOrderFront`. The ten mutants include none for
this ordering.

**Suggested change.** Make the ordering observable (the controller takes its two order calls as
closures, or the row activates the probe as `cursor_keys_proof.swift:111` does and asserts
`show()` IS key and `showAutomatic()` is NOT), with an `auto-takes-key` mutant, and record in
TIP-7 why the set passes ten or drop one of the threshold pair.

## 3. `screens.py` P2 fails on the three state keys

**Claim.** The plan pins only `FrameJobTips` in `screens.py`; the other three new keys are left
uncovered and P2 fails the catalog run.

**Evidence.** `tools/proof/screens.py:1326-1337`: P2 collects every
`static let \w*Key = "(FrameJob|RC)…"` literal in `app/Sources` and fails with "keys neither
pinned nor in NOT_SHOWN" for any not in `PINS` or `NOT_SHOWN` (`:255-257`). The plan's own
mould declares keys exactly that way (`BackgroundRender.swift:9,11`, `enabledKey`,
`delayKey`), so `FrameJobTipsExports`, `FrameJobTipsFirstExport` and `FrameJobTipsLastAsked`
land in the scan. `screens.py` is not in `make gate`, so nothing reports it until the next
catalog run.

**Suggested change.** Add the three keys to `NOT_SHOWN` with their reason (read and written
only when an export a person confirmed completes; no screen exports) in the same change, and
name it in the plan's instrument list.

## 4. L1 and L2 depend on the owner's toggle in the shared domain

**Claim.** The live rows read `FrameJobTips` from the bundle's real defaults domain unless the
launch pins it, and only L3's launch is said to.

**Evidence.** The plan runs `tips_proof.py` against Release, whose domain is the owner's own
`com.kgalligan.FrameJob` (root `CLAUDE.md`, "A proof's instance shares its bundle's defaults
domain"). The toggle exists so the owner can untick it; once he has, L1 ("a visible Tips right
of Export…") fails on every run with nothing wrong in the tree. The plan guards `screens.py`
against exactly this (`("FrameJobTips", True)`) but says nothing for L1/L2's instances.

**Suggested change.** Launch L1's and L2's instance with `-FrameJobTips YES` (argument domain,
as L3 uses `NO`), and say so in the row text.

## 5. Four documents the change makes false are not in the plan's list

**Claim.** The plan edits `reference/settings.mdx`, `editor-window.mdx` and
`remembered-choices.mdx:141` but leaves other lines that count Settings' sections or place
Export… last.

**Evidence.**
- `docs/site/src/content/docs/assistant/set-up.mdx:27`: "the second of the window's four
  sections".
- `docs/site/src/data/features.json:20350`: "in four sections: MCP, Assistant, Transcription
  and Playback" (the plan adds rows but does not name this summary).
- `docs/site/src/content/docs/export/export-sheet.mdx:15,23`: "The accent Export… button at the
  right end of the toolbar" (Tips is right of it by default).
- `docs/manual-checks.md:447`: "a display shorter than its four panes".

**Suggested change.** Add these four to the document list (a `rg -n "four (panes|sections)|right end of the toolbar"`
over `docs/` and `designs/screens/` finds them).

## 6. In the light look the button's green is the action ink's green

**Claim.** O7 keeps CI-4 by token name only; in light the two colours are near-identical, and
the plan does not say so to the owner or in TIP-6.

**Evidence.** `Theme.swift:40` `DS.forest` = `#1F8564`; `Theme.swift:118-123` `DS.action` in
light = `#1E8F6E` (10/255 apart in two channels). CI-4
(`designs/spec/11-decisions/chrome-inspector-keys.md:72`): "Mint is the action ink, and nothing
else uses it."

**Suggested change.** State in O7 and TIP-6 that the toolbar button's green matches the action
ink in the light look and that TIP-6 accepts it for this experiment (amending CI-4 by ID), or
pick a green that is apart from it in both looks.

# Spec §11 — decisions: Tips

Part of spec §11, *Decisions made — do not re-litigate*. The index of every decision is
[`README.md`](README.md).

These were made with no road map, from the owner's words of 2026-11-14: a tips dialog, a green
Tips button to the right of Export in the editor, an automatic ask on a usage-then-calendar
schedule, and a Settings section that turns the ask and the button off. The owner called the
button an experiment that may be removed.

- **TIP-1 — A tip is voluntary, nothing in Frame Job is gated on one, and the app holds no payment
  code: the dialog says who a tip funds and opens one web page.** The statement is plain: Frame
  Job is made by one developer, it is free to use and its source is open, a tip helps pay for the
  time to keep working on it, and nothing is locked without one. "Leave a Tip" opens
  `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` in the person's browser, and that address is ONE
  constant (`TipsLink.url`, `Tips.swift`), so moving the page is a one-line change. The page is
  the owner's to make. Frame Job never learns whether anyone tipped, so there is no "thank you"
  state and nothing to restore. Risk accepted: until the page exists the button opens a missing
  page.
- **TIP-2 — The dialog is its own small window titled "Tips", not a sheet and not an app-modal
  alert, and it has three doors: the editor's Tips button, Settings' Tips button and the automatic
  ask.** A sheet needs a host window and two of the doors have no document (Settings, and Settings
  opened from the Welcome window); an app-modal alert would stop every window and would sit in
  front of an MCP client's calls. A window that is modal to nothing cannot make anything wait. It
  is the Settings window's mould (`TipsWindowController`): one instance, not released when closed,
  no frame autosave name (so it writes no `NSWindow Frame` key), built from the sheets' own pieces
  (`makeSheetView`, `makeButtonRow`) so it reads as one of them, Escape on "Not Now" and Return on
  "Leave a Tip". It is left out of the Window menu: a two-button dialog is not a place to come
  back to, and both buttons reopen it. There is no menu item for it, and no MCP mirror, because
  showing it is not an edit (spec §7.9).
- **TIP-3 — The automatic ask is due by usage first and the calendar after: never while the
  toggle is off; first once at least 5 exports are counted AND at least 30 × 24 hours have passed
  since the first counted export; after an ask, only in a December, and a December is skipped
  whole when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask.** The rule
  is one pure function, `TipsSchedule.isDue(_:now:calendar:)`, over the stored state, the moment
  and a calendar. "30 days of use" counts from the first counted export and not from the first
  launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof make, and a date stamped at launch
  would count use by agents alone. It is elapsed time, not thirty separate days of use, which
  would make an occasional user wait a year. "December" is month 12 of the GREGORIAN calendar in
  the Mac's current time zone (`TipsSchedule.localCalendar()`, built at each evaluation), whatever
  calendar the person's Mac shows, so the same instant can be December in Auckland and November
  in Los Angeles. A December is judged whole so that an ask on 30 June cannot bring the next one
  on 30 December: a last ask after 1 June 00:00 skips that year's December, and one at or before
  it does not. A clock set back before the last ask or the first export makes nothing due. Risk
  accepted: the rule is evaluated only when a counted export completes (TIP-4), so a person who
  exports nothing in December is not asked that year.
- **TIP-4 — Only an export a person confirmed in the export card counts, and only its completion
  evaluates the ask; the agent's `export` never does either.** The card's two commits both sit
  behind its save panel (`ExportSheetCommit.swift`), which no tool and no dev switch answers:
  Export… (`EditorViewController.beginExport`) and Add to Queue (`enqueueExport`). The first hands
  the progress sheet an `onSuccess` it calls once, on a success only; the second follows its job
  by the id `enqueue` answered (`TipsQueueFollower`, `AgentExports`' pattern), so
  `ExportQueueController` is not changed and its jobs carry no origin. The agent's `export`
  enqueues on the same queue and is never followed, and the Assistant tab's `export` is that same
  door. So an instance driven only by an MCP client, the assistant or a proof counts nothing,
  writes no key and is never shown the dialog, which is what keeps `mcp.py`'s `DEFAULTS MOVED`
  guard quiet. A counted export is counted when it succeeds. The ask is evaluated, and recorded,
  at the moment it is shown: for Export…, when the result sheet ends (Close or Show in Finder),
  one main-queue turn later; for a queued job, when it completes. The automatic ask is ordered
  front WITHOUT becoming key, so a Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip";
  the two buttons' doors make it key. Risks accepted: after Show in Finder the dialog appears
  behind Finder and is found on return; a window closed with its result sheet still attached

Tips button to the right of Export in the editor, an automatic ask on a usage-then-calendar
schedule, and a Settings section that turns the ask and the button off. The owner called the
button an experiment that may be removed.

- **TIP-1 — A tip is voluntary, nothing in Frame Job is gated on one, and the app holds no payment
  code: the dialog says who a tip funds and opens one web page.** The statement is plain: Frame
  Job is made by one developer, it is free to use and its source is open, a tip helps pay for the
  time to keep working on it, and nothing is locked without one. "Leave a Tip" opens
  `https://boppallewyn.com/frame-job/tips/` in the person's browser, and that address is ONE
  constant (`TipsLink.url`, `Tips.swift`), so moving the page is a one-line change. The page is
  the owner's to make. Frame Job never learns whether anyone tipped, so there is no "thank you"
  state and nothing to restore. Risk accepted: until the page exists the button opens a missing
  page.
- **TIP-2 — The dialog is its own small window titled "Tips", not a sheet and not an app-modal
  alert, and it has three doors: the editor's Tips button, Settings' Tips button and the automatic
  ask.** A sheet needs a host window and two of the doors have no document (Settings, and Settings
  opened from the Welcome window); an app-modal alert would stop every window and would sit in
  front of an MCP client's calls. A window that is modal to nothing cannot make anything wait. It
  is the Settings window's mould (`TipsWindowController`): one instance, not released when closed,
  no frame autosave name (so it writes no `NSWindow Frame` key), built from the sheets' own pieces
  (`makeSheetView`, `makeButtonRow`) so it reads as one of them, Escape on "Not Now" and Return on
  "Leave a Tip". It is left out of the Window menu: a two-button dialog is not a place to come
  back to, and both buttons reopen it. There is no menu item for it, and no MCP mirror, because
  showing it is not an edit (spec §7.9).
- **TIP-3 — The automatic ask is due by usage first and the calendar after: never while the
  toggle is off; first once at least 5 exports are counted AND at least 30 × 24 hours have passed
  since the first counted export; after an ask, only in a December, and a December is skipped
  whole when its 1 December 00:00 is less than six calendar months after the last ask.** The rule
  is one pure function, `TipsSchedule.isDue(_:now:calendar:)`, over the stored state, the moment
  and a calendar. "30 days of use" counts from the first counted export and not from the first
  launch: a launch is also what `framejob-mcp` and every proof make, and a date stamped at launch
  would count use by agents alone. It is elapsed time, not thirty separate days of use, which
  would make an occasional user wait a year. "December" is month 12 of the GREGORIAN calendar in
  the Mac's current time zone (`TipsSchedule.localCalendar()`, built at each evaluation), whatever
  calendar the person's Mac shows, so the same instant can be December in Auckland and November
  in Los Angeles. A December is judged whole so that an ask on 30 June cannot bring the next one
  on 30 December: a last ask after 1 June 00:00 skips that year's December, and one at or before
  it does not. A clock set back before the last ask or the first export makes nothing due. Risk
  accepted: the rule is evaluated only when a counted export completes (TIP-4), so a person who
  exports nothing in December is not asked that year.
- **TIP-4 — Only an export a person confirmed in the export card counts, and only its completion
  evaluates the ask; the agent's `export` never does either.** The card's two commits both sit
  behind its save panel (`ExportSheetCommit.swift`), which no tool and no dev switch answers:

  the progress sheet an `onSuccess` it calls once, on a success only; the second follows its job

  enqueues on the same queue and is never followed, and the Assistant tab's `export` is that same
  door. So an instance driven only by an MCP client, the assistant or a proof counts nothing,
  writes no key and is never shown the dialog, which is what keeps `mcp.py`'s `DEFAULTS MOVED`
  guard quiet. A counted export is counted when it succeeds. The ask is evaluated, and recorded,
  at the moment it is shown: for Export…, when the result sheet ends (Close or Show in Finder),
  one main-queue turn later; for a queued job, when it completes. The automatic ask is ordered
  front WITHOUT becoming key, so a Return typed into the editor can never press "Leave a Tip";
  the two buttons' doors make it key. Risks accepted: after Show in Finder the dialog appears
  behind Finder and is found on return; a window closed with its result sheet still attached
  never ends that sheet, so that export is counted and the ask waits for the next one.

  format changes. Risk accepted: the state is per Mac and per build identity, so a Debug build

- **TIP-6 — The editor's Tips button is an `AccentButton` filled with `DS.tips` (`#2E7D32`), right

# ---- the run ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parity(log, tag):
    try:
        lines = [line.strip() for line in open(log, errors="replace") if "Frame Job: " in line]
    except OSError:
        lines = [f"{log} could not be read"]
    check("Z1", not lines, f"{tag}: grep 'Frame Job: ' printed {lines[:3] or 'nothing'}")


def launch(binary, arguments, rows, body, tag):
    log = WORK / f"{tag}.log"
    env = bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(HOME)})
    launched = mcp.launch(str(binary), arguments, env=env, log_path=str(log), timeout=CALL_BOUND)
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            for row in sorted(rows):
                broken.add(row)
                check(row, False, "the instance did not listen")
            return
        print(f"  {tag}: instance PID {launched.child.pid}", flush=True)
        body(launched.client)
    finally:
        launched.stop()
        parity(log, tag)


def run_rows(binary, manifest):
    first = selected & set(LAUNCH_ONE)

        launch(binary, vr6b.LAUNCH_1, first, lambda c: tool_rows(c, manifest), "launch-1")
    second = selected & set(LAUNCH_TWO)
    if second:
        launch(binary, LAUNCH_2, second, lambda c: sheet_rows(c, manifest), "launch-2")

ask and Settings' section.

    python3 tools/proof/tips_proof.py [--only ROW,…] [--no-live] [--mutant NAME]

A plain run builds `tips_probe.swift` over `app/Sources` through
`swift_build.build` and runs it once (B0, S, A, F, C, W), reads the tree's own
text (T1), then drives two instances of the app `RC_PROOF_APP` chooses over
MCP (L). `--no-live` leaves the L rows out. Every string and number a probe
row compares is a literal in the probe.

  B0   the probe builds.
  S1   nothing recorded, and five exports with no first export: not due.
  S2   five exports: 29 d 23 h after the first is not due, 30 d after (1 July)
       is.
  S3   four exports after 400 d is not due; five is.
  S4   the toggle off with everything else due: not due.
  S5   after an ask on 10 February: 15 July no, 30 November 23:59:59 no,
       1 December 00:00:00 yes, 31 December 23:59:59 yes, 1 January no.
  S6   a last ask at 1 June 00:00:00 leaves that December due; at 00:00:01 it

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "graphics_spike"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import swift_build  # noqa: E402

WORK = ROOT / "tools/proof/work/tips"
PROBE_ROWS = (["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "S9", "S10",
               "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "F1", "F2", "F3",
               "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "W2", "W1", "W3"])
LIVE_ROWS = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3"]
ROWS = ["B0"] + PROBE_ROWS + ["T1"] + LIVE_ROWS
WALL = 480
CALL_BOUND = 180
DOOR = "EditorViewController+Export.swift"
WINDOW = "TipsWindowController.swift"

# name: (the rows it must fail, [(file, before, after), ...])
MUTANTS = {
    "days-ignored": (["S2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard now.timeIntervalSince(first) >= Double(firstAskDays) * 86_400 "
         "else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "exports-ignored": (["S3"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard state.exports >= firstAskExports else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "toggle-ignored": (["S4", "A3"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard state.enabled else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "any-month": (["S5"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "guard calendar.component(.month, from: now) == 12 else { return false }",
         "guard calendar.component(.month, from: now) >= 1 else { return false }")]),
    "skip-ignored": (["S6", "S7"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        return earliest <= december\n",
         "        return earliest <= december || true\n")]),
    "ask-unrecorded": (["A2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        defaults.set(moment, forKey: Self.lastAskedKey)\n",
         "")]),
    "cancelled-counts": (["F2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "            case .cancelled, .failed, nil:\n                followed.remove(id)\n",
         "            case .cancelled, .failed, nil:\n                followed.remove(id)\n"
         "                completed()\n")]),
    "agent-follows": (["T1"], [
        ("AgentServer+Export.swift",
         "            AgentExports.shared.track(\n",
         "            TipsDoors.shared.follow(queueJob: id)\n"
         "            AgentExports.shared.track(\n")]),
    "button-ignores-toggle": (["C3"], [
        ("TipsToolbarButton.swift",
         "isHidden = !TipsSettings.isEnabled(in: defaults)",
         "isHidden = false")]),
    "toggle-unposted": (["C4"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: didChangeNotification, object: nil)\n",
         "")]),
    "success-unwired": (["W1"], [
        ("ExportProgressSheetController.swift",
         "            onSuccess?()\n",
         "")]),
    "auto-takes-key": (["C1", "W1", "W3"], [
        ("TipsWindowController.swift",
         "        orderFront(window)\n",
         "        orderKey(window)\n")]),
}


def build(sources, here):
    """(binary, None) or (None, why): `swift_build.build`, without the
    dev-tools flag (nothing here needs it)."""
    entry = here / "main.swift"
    shutil.copyfile(HERE / "tips_probe.swift", entry)
    binary = here / "tips-probe"
    swift = sorted(str(p) for p in sources.glob("*.swift") if p.name != "main.swift")
    if len(swift) < 100:
        return None, "app source set incomplete"
    try:
        swift_build.build(sources=swift + [entry], output=binary)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        return None, "swiftc: " + "; ".join(error.diagnostics[:8])
    return binary, None


def mutate(sources, name, dest):
    """A copy of `sources` with the mutant's edits; None, or why when a
    `before` text is not found exactly once."""
    shutil.copytree(sources, dest)
    for file, before, after in MUTANTS[name][1]:
        path = dest / file
        text = path.read_text() if path.exists() else ""
        if text.count(before) != 1:
            return f"{file}: `{before}` found {text.count(before)} times"
        path.write_text(text.replace(before, after))
    return None


def probe(binary, here):
    """(the probe's answer, None), or (None, why)."""
    scratch = here / "scratch"
    scratch.mkdir()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [str(binary), str(scratch), str(ROOT / "app/Resources/Fonts")],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=WALL, cwd=here, env=bounded.child_env())
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return None, f"no answer within {WALL} s"
    (here / "stderr.txt").write_text(result.stderr)
    try:
        answer = json.loads(result.stdout)
        answer["rows"]
        return answer, None
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return None, f"no answer (exit {result.returncode}): {result.stderr[-400:]}"


# ---- T1: the tree's text ----------------------------------------------------------

def tree_row(sources):
    texts = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in sorted(sources.glob("*.swift"))}

    def files(needle):
        return sorted(name for name, text in texts.items() if needle in text)

    def count(needle):
        return sum(text.count(needle) for text in texts.values())

    facts = [
        (".exportSucceeded( is called once, in the export door",
         count(".exportSucceeded(") == 1 and files(".exportSucceeded(") == [DOOR]),
        (".follow(queueJob: is called once, in the export door",
         count(".follow(queueJob:") == 1 and files(".follow(queueJob:") == [DOOR]),
        ("TipsDoors is named in the export door and its own file alone",
         files("TipsDoors") == sorted([DOOR, WINDOW])),
        (".takeAsk( is called in the Tips window's file alone", files(".takeAsk(") == [WINDOW]),
        (".countExport( is called in the Tips window's file alone",
         files(".countExport(") == [WINDOW]),
    ]
    detail = "; ".join(f"{name} {ok}" for name, ok in facts)
    detail += (f" (exportSucceeded in {files('.exportSucceeded(')}, follow in "
               f"{files('.follow(queueJob:')}, TipsDoors in {files('TipsDoors')})")
    return all(ok for _, ok in facts), detail


# ---- L: the app over MCP ----------------------------------------------------------

def png_colours(path):
    """How many distinct byte values the PNG's inflated image data holds; 0
    when it cannot be read. One colour inflates to a handful."""
    try:
        data = Path(path).read_bytes()
        at, chunks = 8, []
        while at + 8 <= len(data):
            length = int.from_bytes(data[at:at + 4], "big")
            if data[at + 4:at + 8] == b"IDAT":
                chunks.append(data[at + 8:at + 8 + length])
            at += 12 + length
        return len(set(zlib.decompress(b"".join(chunks))))
    except Exception:  # an unreadable capture is a failed row, not a crash
        return 0


def views_of(answer):
    with open(answer["layout_path"]) as handle:
        return json.load(handle)["views"]


def shown(views, text=None, ident=None):
    return [v for v in views if not v.get("hidden")
            and (text is None or v.get("text") == text)
            and (ident is None or v.get("id") == ident)]


def instance(binary, tag, toggle, session, results, body):
    """One instance with `-FrameJobTips <toggle>`; its parity line joins L0."""
    log = session / f"{tag}.log"
    home = session / f"home-{tag}"
    home.mkdir(parents=True)
    arguments = ["-NSRecentDocumentsLimit", "0", "-FrameJobTips", toggle]
    launched = mcp.launch(str(binary), arguments=arguments,
                          env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(home)}),
                          log_path=str(log), timeout=CALL_BOUND)
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"the instance did not listen (log {log})")
        print(f"  {tag}: instance PID {launched.child.pid}", flush=True)
        body(launched)
    finally:
        launched.stop()
        try:
            lines = [line.strip() for line in open(log, errors="replace")
                     if "Frame Job: " in line]
        except OSError:
            lines = [f"{log} could not be read"]
        results.setdefault("parity", []).append((tag, lines))
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)


def live(wanted):
    results = {}
    answers = {}
    session = WORK / "live"
    if session.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(session)
    out = session / "out"
    out.mkdir(parents=True)

    def fail_all(why):
        for row in LIVE_ROWS:
            answers.setdefault(row, (False, why))

    try:
        binary = proof_app.executable(proof_app.bundle())
    except Exception as error:  # no app is every live row's failure
        fail_all(f"no app: {error}")
        return answers

    def toolbar(client, project, name):
        return client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {
            "project": project, "window": "editor", "view": "toolbar",
            "path": str(out / name), "fill_preview": False})

    def on(launched):
        client = launched.client
        project = str(session / "on.framejob")
        client.call_with("new_project", {"path": project})
        answer = toolbar(client, project, "toolbar-on.png")
        views = views_of(answer)
        tips = shown(views, text="Tips", ident="toolbar.tips")
        export = shown(views, text="Export…")
        colours = png_colours(out / "toolbar-on.png")
        right = bool(tips and export
                     and tips[0]["frame"][0] >= export[0]["frame"][0] + export[0]["frame"][2])
        answers["L1"] = (
            len(tips) == 1 and len(export) == 1 and right and colours > 8,
            f"visible Tips views {[v['frame'] for v in tips]}, Export… "
            f"{[v['frame'] for v in export]}, Tips right of Export… {right}; the PNG's data "
            f"holds {colours} byte values")

        got = client.call_with("get_project", {"project": project})["project"]
        client.call_with("add_shape_clip", {
            "project": project, "track": got["tracks"][0]["id"], "at": 0, "duration": 600000})
        done = client.export_with(
            {"project": project, "preset": "h264", "path": str(out / "agent.mp4")},
            seconds=CALL_BOUND)
        listing = client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {})
        titles = [w.get("title") for w in listing.get("windows", [])]
        moved = mcp.defaults_moved(launched.socket_path)
        answers["L2"] = (
            isinstance(done, dict) and (out / "agent.mp4").exists() and "Tips" not in titles
            and moved == [],
            f"export answered {done.get('status') if isinstance(done, dict) else done!r}, the "
            f"file exists {(out / 'agent.mp4').exists()}; visible windows {titles}; defaults "
            f"moved {moved}")
        client.call_with("close_project", {"project": project, "discard": True})

    def off(launched):
        client = launched.client
        project = str(session / "off.framejob")
        client.call_with("new_project", {"path": project})
        views = views_of(toolbar(client, project, "toolbar-off.png"))
        tips = shown(views, text="Tips")
        export = shown(views, text="Export…")
        client.call_with("perform_menu_item", {"path": ["Frame Job", "Settings…"]})
        settings = views_of(client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {
            "window": "settings", "path": str(out / "settings-off.png")}))
        button = shown(settings, text="Tips", ident="settings.tips.button")
        toggle = shown(settings, text="Show the Tips button and the yearly reminder",
                       ident="settings.tips.toggle")
        answers["L3"] = (
            not tips and len(export) == 1 and len(button) == 1 and len(toggle) == 1,
            f"toolbar views reading Tips {len(tips)}, Export… {len(export)}; Settings' Tips "
            f"button {len(button)}, toggle {len(toggle)}")
        client.call_with("close_project", {"project": project, "discard": True})

    for tag, toggle, body, rows in (("on", "YES", on, ["L1", "L2"]), ("off", "NO", off, ["L3"])):
        if not set(rows) & set(wanted) and "L0" not in wanted:
            continue
        try:
            instance(binary, tag, toggle, session, results, body)
        except Exception as error:  # a row that could not run is that row's failure
            for row in rows:
                answers.setdefault(row, (False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"))
    parity = results.get("parity", [])
    answers["L0"] = (
        len(parity) > 0 and all(not lines for _, lines in parity),
        "; ".join(f"{tag}: {lines[:2] or 'nothing'}" for tag, lines in parity) or "no instance ran")
    fail_all("not run")
    return answers


# ---- the run ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--sources", type=Path, default=ROOT / "app/Sources")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(MUTANTS))
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated row ids")
    parser.add_argument("--no-live", action="store_true", help="leave the L rows out")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    named = MUTANTS[args.mutant][0] if args.mutant else []
    if args.only:
        wanted = args.only.split(",")
    elif args.mutant:
        wanted = ["B0"] + named
    else:
        wanted = [row for row in ROWS if not (args.no_live and row in LIVE_ROWS)]
    unknown = [row for row in wanted if row not in ROWS]
    if unknown:
        print("unknown row " + ", ".join(unknown))
        return 2
    if args.mutant and set(wanted) & set(LIVE_ROWS):
        print("a mutant is a probe rebuild; the L rows do not run under one")
        return 2
    here = WORK / (f"mutant-{args.mutant}" if args.mutant else "tree")
    if here.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(here)
    here.mkdir(parents=True)
    sources = args.sources.resolve()
    if args.mutant:
        why = mutate(sources, args.mutant, here / "Sources")
        if why:
            print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — {why}")
            return 2
        sources = here / "Sources"

    results = {}
    not_scored = []
    probe_wanted = [row for row in wanted if row in PROBE_ROWS]
    if "B0" in wanted or probe_wanted:
        binary, why = build(sources, here)
        results["B0"] = (binary is not None, why or f"built from {sources}")
        if binary is None and args.mutant:
            print(f"B0 fail — {why}")
            print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — the copy did "
                  "not build")
            return 2
        if probe_wanted:
            if binary is None:
                for row in probe_wanted:
                    results[row] = (False, "not run: the probe did not build")
            else:
                answer, why = probe(binary, here)
                rows = (answer or {}).get("rows") or []
                for row in probe_wanted:
                    found = next((a for a in rows if a.get("id") == row), None)
                    if found is None:
                        not_scored.append(row)
                        results[row] = (False, f"no row: {why or 'the probe did not answer it'}")
                    else:
                        results[row] = (bool(found["pass"]), found["detail"])
    if "T1" in wanted:
        results["T1"] = tree_row(sources)
    if set(wanted) & set(LIVE_ROWS):
        results.update(live(wanted))

    for row in wanted:
        good, detail = results[row]
        print(f"{row} {'pass' if good else 'fail'} — {detail}")
    passed = sum(1 for row in wanted if results[row][0])
    print(f"scores: {passed}/{len(wanted)}")
    if not args.mutant:
        return 0 if passed == len(wanted) else 1
    lost = [row for row in named if row in not_scored or row not in results]
    if lost:
        print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — "
              f"{', '.join(lost)} not scored")
        return 2
    survived = [row for row in named if results[row][0]]
    if survived:
        print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: SURVIVED — {', '.join(survived)} passed")
        return 0
    print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: CAUGHT — {', '.join(named)} failed")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "graphics_spike"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import swift_build  # noqa: E402

WORK = ROOT / "tools/proof/work/tips"
PROBE_ROWS = (["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "S9", "S10",
               "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "F1", "F2", "F3",
               "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "W2", "W1", "W3"])
LIVE_ROWS = ["L0", "L1", "L2", "L3"]
ROWS = ["B0"] + PROBE_ROWS + ["T1"] + LIVE_ROWS
WALL = 480
CALL_BOUND = 180
DOOR = "EditorViewController+Export.swift"
WINDOW = "TipsWindowController.swift"

# name: (the rows it must fail, [(file, before, after), ...])
MUTANTS = {
    "days-ignored": (["S2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard now.timeIntervalSince(first) >= Double(firstAskDays) * 86_400 "
         "else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "exports-ignored": (["S3"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard state.exports >= firstAskExports else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "toggle-ignored": (["S4", "A3"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        guard state.enabled else { return false }\n",
         "")]),
    "any-month": (["S5"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "guard calendar.component(.month, from: now) == 12 else { return false }",
         "guard calendar.component(.month, from: now) >= 1 else { return false }")]),
    "skip-ignored": (["S6", "S7"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        return earliest <= december\n",
         "        return earliest <= december || true\n")]),
    "ask-unrecorded": (["A2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        defaults.set(moment, forKey: Self.lastAskedKey)\n",
         "")]),
    "cancelled-counts": (["F2"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "            case .cancelled, .failed, nil:\n                followed.remove(id)\n",
         "            case .cancelled, .failed, nil:\n                followed.remove(id)\n"
         "                completed()\n")]),
    "agent-follows": (["T1"], [
        ("AgentServer+Export.swift",
         "            AgentExports.shared.track(\n",
         "            TipsDoors.shared.follow(queueJob: id)\n"
         "            AgentExports.shared.track(\n")]),
    "button-ignores-toggle": (["C3"], [
        ("TipsToolbarButton.swift",
         "isHidden = !TipsSettings.isEnabled(in: defaults)",
         "isHidden = false")]),
    "toggle-unposted": (["C4"], [
        ("Tips.swift",
         "        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: didChangeNotification, object: nil)\n",
         "")]),
    "success-unwired": (["W1"], [
        ("ExportProgressSheetController.swift",
         "            onSuccess?()\n",
         "")]),
    "auto-takes-key": (["C1", "W1", "W3"], [
        ("TipsWindowController.swift",
         "        orderFront(window)\n",
         "        orderKey(window)\n")]),
}


def build(sources, here):
    """(binary, None) or (None, why): `swift_build.build`, without the
    dev-tools flag (nothing here needs it)."""
    entry = here / "main.swift"
    shutil.copyfile(HERE / "tips_probe.swift", entry)
    binary = here / "tips-probe"
    swift = sorted(str(p) for p in sources.glob("*.swift") if p.name != "main.swift")
    if len(swift) < 100:
        return None, "app source set incomplete"
    try:
        swift_build.build(sources=swift + [entry], output=binary)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        return None, "swiftc: " + "; ".join(error.diagnostics[:8])
    return binary, None


def mutate(sources, name, dest):
    """A copy of `sources` with the mutant's edits; None, or why when a
    `before` text is not found exactly once."""
    shutil.copytree(sources, dest)
    for file, before, after in MUTANTS[name][1]:
        path = dest / file
        text = path.read_text() if path.exists() else ""
        if text.count(before) != 1:
            return f"{file}: `{before}` found {text.count(before)} times"
        path.write_text(text.replace(before, after))
    return None


def probe(binary, here):
    """(the probe's answer, None), or (None, why)."""
    scratch = here / "scratch"
    scratch.mkdir()
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [str(binary), str(scratch), str(ROOT / "app/Resources/Fonts")],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=WALL, cwd=here, env=bounded.child_env())
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return None, f"no answer within {WALL} s"
    (here / "stderr.txt").write_text(result.stderr)
    try:
        answer = json.loads(result.stdout)
        answer["rows"]
        return answer, None
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return None, f"no answer (exit {result.returncode}): {result.stderr[-400:]}"


# ---- T1: the tree's text ----------------------------------------------------------

def tree_row(sources):
    texts = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in sorted(sources.glob("*.swift"))}

    def files(needle):
        return sorted(name for name, text in texts.items() if needle in text)

    def count(needle):
        return sum(text.count(needle) for text in texts.values())

    facts = [
        (".exportSucceeded( is called once, in the export door",
         count(".exportSucceeded(") == 1 and files(".exportSucceeded(") == [DOOR]),
        (".follow(queueJob: is called once, in the export door",
         count(".follow(queueJob:") == 1 and files(".follow(queueJob:") == [DOOR]),
        ("TipsDoors is named in the export door and its own file alone",
         files("TipsDoors") == sorted([DOOR, WINDOW])),
        (".takeAsk( is called in the Tips window's file alone", files(".takeAsk(") == [WINDOW]),
        (".countExport( is called in the Tips window's file alone",
         files(".countExport(") == [WINDOW]),
    ]
    detail = "; ".join(f"{name} {ok}" for name, ok in facts)
    detail += (f" (exportSucceeded in {files('.exportSucceeded(')}, follow in "
               f"{files('.follow(queueJob:')}, TipsDoors in {files('TipsDoors')})")
    return all(ok for _, ok in facts), detail


# ---- L: the app over MCP ----------------------------------------------------------

def png_colours(path):
    """How many distinct byte values the PNG's inflated image data holds; 0
    when it cannot be read. One colour inflates to a handful."""
    try:
        data = Path(path).read_bytes()
        at, chunks = 8, []
        while at + 8 <= len(data):
            length = int.from_bytes(data[at:at + 4], "big")
            if data[at + 4:at + 8] == b"IDAT":
                chunks.append(data[at + 8:at + 8 + length])
            at += 12 + length
        return len(set(zlib.decompress(b"".join(chunks))))
    except Exception:  # an unreadable capture is a failed row, not a crash
        return 0


def views_of(answer):
    with open(answer["layout_path"]) as handle:
        return json.load(handle)["views"]


def shown(views, text=None, ident=None):
    return [v for v in views if not v.get("hidden")
            and (text is None or v.get("text") == text)
            and (ident is None or v.get("id") == ident)]


def instance(binary, tag, toggle, session, results, body):
    """One instance with `-FrameJobTips <toggle>`; its parity line joins L0."""
    log = session / f"{tag}.log"
    home = session / f"home-{tag}"
    home.mkdir(parents=True)
    arguments = ["-NSRecentDocumentsLimit", "0", "-FrameJobTips", toggle]
    launched = mcp.launch(str(binary), arguments=arguments,
                          env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(home)}),
                          log_path=str(log), timeout=CALL_BOUND)
    try:
        if launched.client is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"the instance did not listen (log {log})")
        print(f"  {tag}: instance PID {launched.child.pid}", flush=True)
        body(launched)
    finally:
        launched.stop()
        try:
            lines = [line.strip() for line in open(log, errors="replace")
                     if "Frame Job: " in line]
        except OSError:
            lines = [f"{log} could not be read"]
        results.setdefault("parity", []).append((tag, lines))
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)


def live(wanted):
    results = {}
    answers = {}
    session = WORK / "live"
    if session.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(session)
    out = session / "out"
    out.mkdir(parents=True)

    def fail_all(why):
        for row in LIVE_ROWS:
            answers.setdefault(row, (False, why))

    try:
        binary = proof_app.executable(proof_app.bundle())
    except Exception as error:  # no app is every live row's failure
        fail_all(f"no app: {error}")
        return answers

    def toolbar(client, project, name):
        return client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {
            "project": project, "window": "editor", "view": "toolbar",
            "path": str(out / name), "fill_preview": False})

    def on(launched):
        client = launched.client
        project = str(session / "on.framejob")
        client.call_with("new_project", {"path": project})
        answer = toolbar(client, project, "toolbar-on.png")
        views = views_of(answer)
        tips = shown(views, text="Tips", ident="toolbar.tips")
        export = shown(views, text="Export…")
        colours = png_colours(out / "toolbar-on.png")
        right = bool(tips and export
                     and tips[0]["frame"][0] >= export[0]["frame"][0] + export[0]["frame"][2])
        answers["L1"] = (
            len(tips) == 1 and len(export) == 1 and right and colours > 8,
            f"visible Tips views {[v['frame'] for v in tips]}, Export… "
            f"{[v['frame'] for v in export]}, Tips right of Export… {right}; the PNG's data "
            f"holds {colours} byte values")

        got = client.call_with("get_project", {"project": project})["project"]
        client.call_with("add_shape_clip", {
            "project": project, "track": got["tracks"][0]["id"], "at": 0, "duration": 600000})
        done = client.export_with(
            {"project": project, "preset": "h264", "path": str(out / "agent.mp4")},
            seconds=CALL_BOUND)
        listing = client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {})
        titles = [w.get("title") for w in listing.get("windows", [])]
        moved = mcp.defaults_moved(launched.socket_path)
        answers["L2"] = (
            isinstance(done, dict) and (out / "agent.mp4").exists() and "Tips" not in titles
            and moved == [],
            f"export answered {done.get('status') if isinstance(done, dict) else done!r}, the "
            f"file exists {(out / 'agent.mp4').exists()}; visible windows {titles}; defaults "
            f"moved {moved}")
        client.call_with("close_project", {"project": project, "discard": True})

    def off(launched):
        client = launched.client
        project = str(session / "off.framejob")
        client.call_with("new_project", {"path": project})
        views = views_of(toolbar(client, project, "toolbar-off.png"))
        tips = shown(views, text="Tips")
        export = shown(views, text="Export…")
        client.call_with("perform_menu_item", {"path": ["Frame Job", "Settings…"]})
        settings = views_of(client.call_with("snapshot_ui", {
            "window": "settings", "path": str(out / "settings-off.png")}))
        button = shown(settings, text="Tips", ident="settings.tips.button")
        toggle = shown(settings, text="Show the Tips button and the yearly reminder",
                       ident="settings.tips.toggle")
        answers["L3"] = (
            not tips and len(export) == 1 and len(button) == 1 and len(toggle) == 1,
            f"toolbar views reading Tips {len(tips)}, Export… {len(export)}; Settings' Tips "
            f"button {len(button)}, toggle {len(toggle)}")
        client.call_with("close_project", {"project": project, "discard": True})

    for tag, toggle, body, rows in (("on", "YES", on, ["L1", "L2"]), ("off", "NO", off, ["L3"])):
        if not set(rows) & set(wanted) and "L0" not in wanted:
            continue
        try:
            instance(binary, tag, toggle, session, results, body)
        except Exception as error:  # a row that could not run is that row's failure
            for row in rows:
                answers.setdefault(row, (False, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"))
    parity = results.get("parity", [])
    answers["L0"] = (
        len(parity) > 0 and all(not lines for _, lines in parity),
        "; ".join(f"{tag}: {lines[:2] or 'nothing'}" for tag, lines in parity) or "no instance ran")
    fail_all("not run")
    return answers


# ---- the run ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--sources", type=Path, default=ROOT / "app/Sources")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(MUTANTS))
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated row ids")
    parser.add_argument("--no-live", action="store_true", help="leave the L rows out")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    named = MUTANTS[args.mutant][0] if args.mutant else []
    if args.only:
        wanted = args.only.split(",")
    elif args.mutant:
        wanted = ["B0"] + named
    else:
        wanted = [row for row in ROWS if not (args.no_live and row in LIVE_ROWS)]
    unknown = [row for row in wanted if row not in ROWS]
    if unknown:
        print("unknown row " + ", ".join(unknown))
        return 2
    if args.mutant and set(wanted) & set(LIVE_ROWS):
        print("a mutant is a probe rebuild; the L rows do not run under one")
        return 2
    here = WORK / (f"mutant-{args.mutant}" if args.mutant else "tree")
    if here.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(here)
    here.mkdir(parents=True)
    sources = args.sources.resolve()
    if args.mutant:
        why = mutate(sources, args.mutant, here / "Sources")
        if why:
            print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — {why}")
            return 2
        sources = here / "Sources"

    results = {}
    not_scored = []
    probe_wanted = [row for row in wanted if row in PROBE_ROWS]
    if "B0" in wanted or probe_wanted:
        binary, why = build(sources, here)
        results["B0"] = (binary is not None, why or f"built from {sources}")
        if binary is None and args.mutant:
            print(f"B0 fail — {why}")
            print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — the copy did "
                  "not build")
            return 2
        if probe_wanted:
            if binary is None:
                for row in probe_wanted:
                    results[row] = (False, "not run: the probe did not build")
            else:
                answer, why = probe(binary, here)
                rows = (answer or {}).get("rows") or []
                for row in probe_wanted:
                    found = next((a for a in rows if a.get("id") == row), None)
                    if found is None:
                        not_scored.append(row)
                        results[row] = (False, f"no row: {why or 'the probe did not answer it'}")
                    else:
                        results[row] = (bool(found["pass"]), found["detail"])
    if "T1" in wanted:
        results["T1"] = tree_row(sources)
    if set(wanted) & set(LIVE_ROWS):
        results.update(live(wanted))

    for row in wanted:
        good, detail = results[row]
        print(f"{row} {'pass' if good else 'fail'} — {detail}")
    passed = sum(1 for row in wanted if results[row][0])
    print(f"scores: {passed}/{len(wanted)}")
    if not args.mutant:
        return 0 if passed == len(wanted) else 1
    lost = [row for row in named if row in not_scored or row not in results]
    if lost:
        print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: the control could not be performed — "
              f"{', '.join(lost)} not scored")
        return 2
    survived = [row for row in named if results[row][0]]
    if survived:
        print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: SURVIVED — {', '.join(survived)} passed")
        return 0
    print(f"mutant {args.mutant}: CAUGHT — {', '.join(named)} failed")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
